Problem Identification: Interactive explorer to search/filter book reviews, visualize score distribution, and cluster similar reviews; export filtered data.
Data issues / EDA: DB: clustering.db table amazon_book_reviews (~300k rows). Missing columns in current table: Price, review/score, review/helpfulness, review/summary. Unique products ~37,990; prices mostly null; long review texts; helpfulness often absent. Derived scores used when score column missing; heuristics available for predictions if model not trained.
ML Model: Text TF-IDF + TruncatedSVD (128 comps) on Title+Summary+Text; numeric features scaled: [score, helpfulness_ratio, log(price+1)]; clustering via KMeans (k=8 default), DBSCAN, or Agglomerative; heuristic labels used when reviews_cluster.pkl not present.
Preprocess: Build text as Title+summary+text; parse helpfulness x/y; coerce price to float; compute log(price+1); fill missing numeric with 0; derive score from text length when absent; filters applied server-side; CSV export supported.
